instruction: Open Thunderbird and navigate to the Notes folder to find the most recent email with a Word document attachment. Extract the third image from the attached document and set it as the desktop background.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the THIRD image (image3.png) from the .docx attachment in Notes folder email and setting it as desktop wallpaper. Verified: image3.png has SHA256 hash 4e3e2dd11a39dcb6ad6266b97862f66ccdd3cf72eefc384fb6dede4ed2ae9045, dimensions 510x474, size 27669 bytes. Evaluator checks wallpaper file hash matches expected.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts desktop wallpaper state by computing SHA256 hash of /home/user/.config/wallpaper file
Metric comparison logic appropriately uses exact hash matching to verify correct image was set as wallpaper
Expected hash value (4e3e2dd11a39dcb6ad6266b97862f66ccdd3cf72eefc384fb6dede4ed2ae9045) is correctly verified to be image3.png from the Word document
Final state verification (wallpaper hash) implicitly confirms all instruction steps were completed: opened Thunderbird, found email in Notes folder, extracted 3rd image, and set as background
Data flow is logically correct: getter extracts wallpaper hash -> metric compares against expected -> verification succeeds if hashes match
Getter can access the wallpaper file path, and hash comparison handles edge cases (None values, mismatches) appropriately
